problem_disposition.summary: evals/run_evals.py's --live mode needs to detect, per trigger-case prompt, whether the deja-vu skill actually fired inside a headless Claude Code run, without deja-vu building and maintaining a custom log-scraping or reply-text-classification harness.

candidate_comparisons.summary: Claude Code's own `--output-format stream-json --verbose` flag emits a structured JSON event stream for a headless `claude -p` run; a Skill/skill tool_use event whose payload names deja-vu is a direct, structured signal that the skill fired, with no free-text parsing required.

Grepping the plain-text reply for the string "deja-vu" as a fallback when stream-json is unsupported (older Claude Code versions, or a host that only returns final text). Weaker signal — a reply could mention deja-vu without the skill actually having fired, or vice versa — kept only as a degrade path, not the primary detector.
evidence_refs: evals/run_evals.py module docstring: "Falls back to grepping reply text for 'deja-vu' when stream-json is unsupported."

uncertainty.residual: the stream-json event stream's exact field names/format are governed by Claude Code's own release cadence, not deja-vu's; a Claude Code upgrade that changes the event schema could silently break detection, and the module docstring itself flags --live results as directional ("may differ from interactive ones"), not authoritative.
uncertainty.confidence: moderate — the primary path is a direct structured signal, but it is an unversioned external interface deja-vu does not control, and the whole --live mode is explicitly experimental and excluded from CI

reversibility: high — --live is an optional, non-CI mode; reverting to the reply-text-grep fallback (or dropping --live entirely) touches nothing outside evals/run_evals.py

route_components.output_boundary: evals/run_evals.py --live mode: a boolean (fired/silent) per trigger case, derived from the headless session's output stream
accepted_obligations: keep the reply-text-grep fallback maintained so detection degrades instead of failing hard when stream-json is unsupported
route_components.residual_uncertainty: stream-json event schema is an external, unversioned surface that can change under a Claude Code upgrade
route_components.next_action: none — mode is live and experimental by design; revisit if a Claude Code release changes stream-json's event shape
